proposal.rationale: The PersistentVolumeClaim is referencing a non-existent StorageClass "fast-ssd". The recent commit 64ce56658c0310d5e791d7d7cc767baf852f7c60 removed the StorageClass but did not update the PersistentVolumeClaim. The fix is to update the StorageClass to "local-storage" which is an existing StorageClass in the cluster.
proposal.verify: The pod should be scheduled and running after the patch is applied.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          args: ["--maxmemory", "32mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: redis-data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-data
  namespace: demo
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  storageClassName: fast-ssd
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          args: ["--maxmemory", "32mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: redis-data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-data
  namespace: demo
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  storageClassName: fast-ssd
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
